Welcome to Life360 Physiotherapy Center – your trusted destination for Physiotherapy, Chiropractic & Osteopathy care in India. Led by Dr. Nitu Verma (PT), a highly experienced Physiotherapist, Chiropractor & Osteopath, Life360 is committed to providing 360-degree holistic treatment for pain relief, posture correction, spine health, rehabilitation, and overall wellness.

At Life360, we specialize in:
✔️ Back Pain & Neck Pain Treatment
✔️ Slip Disc / Sciatica Relief
✔️ Shoulder, Knee & Joint Pain Care
✔️ Posture Correction & Body Alignment
✔️ Sports Injury Rehab
✔️ Migraine / Headache Treatment
✔️ Foot Scan & Custom Insoles
✔️ Pediatric / Child Posture Care

Our goal is to treat the root cause, not just symptoms, through advanced Physiotherapy, Chiropractic Adjustments, Osteopathy, Rehab Exercises, and personalized care.

📍 Life360 Physiotherapy Center, Raipur - Bhilai
👩‍⚕️ Dr. Nitu Verma (PT)
🌐 Website: life360.co.in

📞 Book Appointment:   09115719395 , 07000784644 , 07714908010
